headline: Hot Money Returns! New Taiwan Dollar Surges 1.32 Cents, Recovers the 32.3 Level - Liberty Finance
summary: The New Taiwan dollar rose sharply against the US dollar and Taiwan stocks gained more than 1,000 points. US stock indexes also closed higher on expectations of a US-Iran agreement on Hormuz passage.
why: The Taiwan dollar and Taiwan Stock Exchange move with global risk sentiment and export demand from its chip sector.

impacts.name: New Taiwan dollar
impacts.why: The input reports the currency rose 1.32 cents against the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of a US-Iran agreement to restore Hormuz passage raised hopes that oil prices would fall, lifting risk assets across markets.
